content.stem: 为何预防金融犯罪如此重要？

options.A: 金融犯罪对社会造成巨大危害,破坏市场诚信,损害消费者和市场参与者的信心
options.B: 金融犯罪风险事件总是会给金融机构带来罚款和损失
options.C: 防范金融犯罪的流程让客户的开户流程变得不必要地繁琐复杂,但却徒增了工作量
options.D: 防范金融犯罪很重要,因为它能降低成本并提升客户服务质量.

content.stem_en: Why is the prevention of financial crime so important?

options_en.A: Financial crime does enormous damage to society, undermining market integrity and consumers' and market participants' confidence
options_en.B: Financial crime risk incidents always result in fines and losses for the financial firm
options_en.C: Financial crime prevention processes make the client onboarding process unnecessarily burdensome and complex and only create additional work
options_en.D: Financial crime prevention is important because it reduces costs and improves customer services
